metadata.portfolio_rebalancing: daily; equal constituent weights; no taxes or transaction costs
metadata.sharpe_convention: (mean daily return - effective daily rf) / sample daily sd * sqrt(252)
metadata.var_convention: negative linear-interpolated 5th return percentile, 1-day loss at 95% confidence
metadata.cvar_convention: negative average return at or below the 5th return percentile
metadata.max_drawdown_convention: minimum wealth / running wealth maximum - 1; includes initial base wealth
metadata.primary_equity_source: Yahoo Finance chart API; NSE underlying-price and corporate-action checks

tests_passed: same dates across all seven series
five NSE close checks within 0.011 INR and documented MUTHOOTFIN 0.05 INR difference
mixed variance equals covariance quadratic form

limitations: Six purposively selected surviving firms do not represent the entire bank or NBFC sector.
Yahoo adjusted close is a vendor total-return proxy, not an independently reconstructed NSE total-return series.
NIFTY 50 is a price index; equity dividend-adjusted performance is not directly like-for-like with its returns. Beta uses the price-index returns.
Shriram pre-30-Nov-2022 history is the predecessor Shriram Transport Finance; the 2022 merger changed the business. HDFC Bank merged with HDFC Limited effective July 2023.
Yahoo BAJFINANCE split event records 2:1 only; official 10x split/bonus factor is already reflected in historical OHLC. Reapplying any factor would corrupt returns.
Retrospective adjusted close levels may incorporate distributions after the sample end; common scaling cancels in within-period returns.
Risk-free rate of 6% is an assumed constant scenario, not a historical realized risk-free series.
Daily rebalancing ignores transaction costs, taxes, liquidity constraints and implementation costs.
No statistical claim about causal effects or all financial institutions is justified by this descriptive sample.
Historical VaR/CVaR are in-sample, one-day estimates and do not bound future losses.
